question: Do newly generated audits/PDFs/decisions/founder approvals survive a fresh Railway deploy when NOT included in the new deployment artifact?

recoveryToday.howRecoveredIfLost: ONLY if the runtime files were pulled back into the deploy workstation/git artifact before the next railway up

architectureFact: Dealality production deploys via Railway CLI working-tree upload that replaces the entire service filesystem (docs/production-deploy/CURRENT_PRODUCTION_DEPLOY_ARCHITECTURE.md). AVA writes to local paths under data/.../production/store and reports/.../archive with no volume mount and no external object store.

smallestDurableFix.whySmallest: Keeps existing file-store API unchanged; only Railway service config + path ensure. No new S3/Airtable schema. Packaged lean baselines can stay in the deploy artifact; runtime store/PDFs live on the volume.
smallestDurableFix.alternative: Object storage (R2/S3) for PDFs + JSON metas — larger change, better multi-instance sharing later.
